‘Ami Birangona Bolchi’ unveils unspoken reality
2023-06-22T19:00:00+06:00 | Zarin Tasnim
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/theatre-arts/news/ami-birangona-bolchi-unveils-unspoken-reality-3353121

In a bold and poignant portrayal of the impact of war on women, the theater production "Ami Birangona Bolchi" by Neelima Ibrahim took center stage at the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy, shedding light on the harrowing truths often left unspoken. Designed and directed by the talented Syed Jamil Ahmed, this groundbreaking production promises to challenge societal norms and open up dialogues that are essential for healing and progress. Supported by the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy, the play will be showcased at the Studio Theatre, National Theatre Complex, until June 30, 2023.

Syed Jamil Ahmed’s 'Ami Birangona Bolchi to stage today

As the curtains rose, the stage came alive with palpable energy, transporting the audience to a time and place scarred by the ravages of war. Neelima Ibrahim's magnum opus, "Ami Birangona Bolchi," has long been recognized as a significant literary document that delves into the profound impact of war on women. The narrative courageously confronts the use of rape as a 'weapon of war' and exposes the ways in which it has been exploited as a means of establishing national identity. While Bangladesh celebrates the golden jubilee of its independence, it is vital that we confront the uncomfortable truths encapsulated within this part of our liberation war, which has often been pushed aside or kept in silence.

Spardha: Independent Theatre Collective has embarked on a momentous endeavor by adapting Neelima Ibrahim's work into a stage production titled "Ami Birangona Bolchi." Under the visionary direction of Syed Jamil Ahmed, this production aims to bring these untold stories to the forefront, encouraging dialogue and understanding while honoring the experiences of those affected.

"Ami Birangona Bolchi" promises to be an emotionally charged and thought-provoking experience for theater enthusiasts and society at large. By tackling sensitive subjects that are often shrouded in silence, the production seeks to challenge existing narratives and foster a collective reflection on the scars left behind by war.

Celebrating the best of art

Complementing the powerful narrative and evocative performances of "Ami Birangona Bolchi," the musical accompaniment by the renowned Ghaashphoring Choir adds an additional layer of emotional depth to the production. Known for their impeccable harmonies and soul-stirring melodies, the choir's music serves as a poignant backdrop, enhancing the audience's connection with the characters and their experiences. The hauntingly beautiful compositions, carefully crafted under the guidance of their talented conductor, resonate with the themes of the play, evoking a range of emotions that further amplify the impact of the performance. The Ghaashphoring Choir's contribution to this theatrical masterpiece is a testament to the transformative power of music in storytelling and promises to leave a lasting impression on all who have the privilege of witnessing their enchanting performances.

‘9+ONE: Interdimensional Journeys’: a spiritual journey in guise of art

The skilled cast, under the expert guidance of Syed Jamil Ahmed, brings forth a profound sense of authenticity and vulnerability to their roles. Their performances aim to capture the strength, resilience, and dignity of the women who endured unimaginable suffering during the war. Through their portrayals, the actors hope to ignite empathy and understanding in the hearts of the audience, urging them to confront the past and strive for a better future.

Director Syed Jamil Ahmed's vision breathed life into the script, creating a visually stunning and emotionally charged production. The seamless integration of lighting, set design, and sound added layers of depth to the narrative, eliciting a range of emotions from the captivated audience. Each scene unfolded with meticulous precision as the talented ensemble cast brought their characters to life with conviction and authenticity.

The Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy's support for this theatrical endeavor further solidified its commitment to promoting and nurturing the arts. By providing a platform for artists to showcase their talents, the Academy continues to foster a vibrant cultural landscape that enriches the lives of the people.

In the aftermath of the performance, the audience erupted into thunderous applause, a testament to the profound impact "Ami Birangona Bolchi" had on their hearts and minds. Conversations reverberated through the halls, with spectators discussing the play's themes and the compelling performances that left them spellbound.
